message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.disable: The ritual is dormant (disabled or Peaceful difficulty).
message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.pattern: Place four Ancient Pedestals 3 blocks from the altar, each with its offering on top. Your Boss Hunts journal names them (by default: gold blocks east and west, soul lanterns south and north).
message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.nearby: A Hollow Sovereign already haunts this area.
message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.space: The Sovereign needs clear space above the altar.
message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.summone: The crown awakens. The Hollow Sovereign has risen!
item.remnant_bosses.boss_journal.tooltip: Use to read your hunts. Sneak at an Ancient Altar with an empty main hand to open them, too.
item.remnant_bosses.boss_journal.progres: Your progress stays with you in this world, even without this journal.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.title: Boss Hunts
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.clue.ossukage: Blackened bones remember a blade. Seek the Ancient Altar and its silent sentinels.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.clue.hollow_s: A ruined citadel under a faded blue banner in the Tarnished Fields, beyond a Waygate. Its legion still guards the gate.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.discover_hint: Witness this boss yourself to reveal its ritual in your journal.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.completed: Hunt complete. Your victory is recorded.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.spacing: Place four Ancient Pedestals exactly 3 blocks from the altar's center: east, west, south and north. Place each offering 1 block above its pedestal.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.activation_hi: Use the activation item on the Ancient Altar when the offerings are in place.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.ritual_unavai: This ritual is unavailable with the current server settings.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.select_hint: Activate to read this hunt. Arrow keys select hunts; Tab moves between controls.
item.remnant_bosses.tarnished_regalia.to: Gilt scraps from the armor of Vael's legion.
A sliver of the king who would not be taken.
Mends Sovereign's Ruin and Regalia armor.
item.remnant_bosses.sovereigns_seal.tool: The wax still bears the Hollow Crown. Use it on the Ancient Altar.
item.remnant_bosses.sovereigns_ruin.tool: The last blade of Vael, still waiting for an order.
Hold use, then release: a spectral crescent that cleaves through three foes.
item.remnant_bosses.sovereigns_sigil.too: His seal of command. The dead still answer it.
Off-hand: tamed allies within 16 blocks strike 10% harder.
Use from the off-hand: call two spectral royal guards. They hold 4 of your max health until they fade.
item.remnant_bosses.sovereigns_sigil.off: The Sigil answers only an empty off-hand… hold it in your off-hand.
item.remnant_bosses.hollow_crown.tooltip: Nothing sits beneath it now. It still expects to be obeyed.
item.remnant_bosses.regalia_cuirass.tool: Ceremonial plate of Vael, gilt over blackened iron.
item.remnant_bosses.regalia_greaves.tool: They knelt to one king, and only once.
item.remnant_bosses.regalia_sabatons.too: Worn smooth on the marble of the throne hall.
item.remnant_bosses.regalia.set.four: Set (4): Unbowed. A heavy blow grants Resistance I (every 20 s).
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.lore.hollow_s: The Last King of Vael bound his soul into his armor so the Oracle could not take it. His command is still being obeyed.
item.remnant_bosses.grave_iron.tooltip.0: Rusted cell iron from the Ossuary Covenant's soul-prisons.
item.remnant_bosses.crypt_key.tooltip.0: Its teeth still fit the Warden's locks. Use it on the Ancient Altar.
item.remnant_bosses.wardens_grasp.toolti: The chain that dragged a thousand souls back to their cells.
Use: throw the hook. A creature is dragged to you; a wall drags you to it.
item.remnant_bosses.gravebound_execution: The headsman's blade of the Covenant. It never asked for a verdict.
+40% damage against slowed or chained foes.
The Warden's seal of office. The cells still answer to it.
Off-hand: undead deal 10% less damage to you.
Use from the off-hand: chain the nearest enemy within 12 blocks in place for 3 s. Costs Wither I for 3 s.
item.remnant_bosses.crypt_sigil.offhand: The Sigil answers only an empty off-hand… hold it in your off-hand.
item.remnant_bosses.crypt_sigil.no_targe: No enemy within reach of the chains.
A rusted iron mask. The last face the condemned ever saw.
item.remnant_bosses.warden_hauberk.toolt: Rusted plate over grave cloth, still hung with cell keys.
item.remnant_bosses.warden_tassets.toolt: Chain-hung plates that rattled down every corridor.
item.remnant_bosses.warden_boots.tooltip: Iron-shod for the long patrol between the cells.
item.remnant_bosses.warden.set.four: Set (4): Jailer's Hold. Melee hits may chain the target for 1 s (15%, every 5 s).
message.remnant_bosses.warden.disabled: The ritual is dormant (disabled or Peaceful difficulty).
message.remnant_bosses.warden.pattern: Place four Ancient Pedestals 3 blocks from the altar, each with its offering on top. Your Boss Hunts journal names them (by default: bone block east, soul soil west, chain south, iron bars north).
message.remnant_bosses.warden.nearby: A Gravebound Warden already keeps its cells nearby.
message.remnant_bosses.warden.space: The Warden needs clear space above the altar.
message.remnant_bosses.warden.summoned: The cell door groans open. The Gravebound Warden has risen!
message.remnant_bosses.warden.realm: The Warden keeps only the cells beneath the eclipse. Perform the rite in the Eclipsed Realm.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.clue.gravebou: Chains rattle deep beneath the Eclipsed Realm. The Covenant's catacombs still keep their prisoners.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.lore.gravebou: When the Oracle shattered, the souls it had taken fell like rain. The Ossuary Covenant caught them and locked them away. Its Warden still keeps the cells, long after there was anyone left to report to.
block.remnant_bosses.grace_ember.tooltip: An ember of the Gracetree. Rest here to heal and to rise here when you fall.
Graces you have touched can be travelled between.
block.remnant_bosses.eclipse_waygate.too: An old arch that still remembers the way into the Eclipsed Realm.
Needs a clear space 3 wide and 4 tall.
Set an Eclipse Shard into it to kindle the way.
block.remnant_bosses.fog_gate.tooltip.0: Challengers may pass. What waits inside may not leave.
item.remnant_bosses.eclipse_shard.toolti: A splinter of the black sun, cold to the touch and faintly gold.
Use it on a Waygate to open the way into the Eclipsed Realm.
message.remnant_bosses.waygate.space: The Waygate needs a clear space 3 wide and 4 tall.
message.remnant_bosses.waygate.dormant: The Waygate is dormant. An Eclipse Shard would wake it.
message.remnant_bosses.waygate.kindle: The Waygate drinks in the eclipse...
message.remnant_bosses.waygate.no_realm: The Eclipsed Realm is missing from this world. Is its datapack disabled?
message.remnant_bosses.sovereign.realm: The Last King answers only beneath the eclipse. Perform the rite in the Eclipsed Realm.
gui.remnant_bosses.grace.title: Grace
gui.remnant_bosses.grace.none: You know no other graces yet.
advancements.remnant_bosses.realm.kindle: Kindle a Waygate with an Eclipse Shard
advancements.remnant_bosses.realm.enter_: Cross a Waygate into the Eclipsed Realm
item.remnant_bosses.memory_shard.tooltip: A splinter of Seyr crystal. Someone's memory is still inside.
item.remnant_bosses.knowledge_fragment.t: A tablet shard from the Lantern Archive, its glyph still lit.
Repairs the Memory Staff and Archivist armor.
Ground from the Observatory's broken lenses. Use it on the Ancient Altar.
item.remnant_bosses.memory_staff.tooltip: The focus Seyr's archivists used to read the crystals.
Use: a homing memory bolt. Hold for 1 s, then release: a ring of 12 bolts.
item.remnant_bosses.watchers_eye.tooltip: The Watcher's crystal eye. It still sees more than it should.
Off-hand: hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow every 10 s.
Use from the off-hand: blink 8 blocks toward where you look. Costs 2 hunger.
item.remnant_bosses.watchers_eye.offhand: The Eye answers only an empty off-hand… hold it in your off-hand.
item.remnant_bosses.watchers_eye.hungry: The Eye needs a fed mind (2 hunger).
item.remnant_bosses.watchers_eye.blocked: No room to blink that way.
item.remnant_bosses.archivist_hood.toolt: A scholar's deep hood. The reading-lamp soot never washed out.
item.remnant_bosses.archivist_robe.toolt: Robe over verdigris plates, clasped with a violet crystal.
item.remnant_bosses.archivist_leggings.t: Worn thin by long nights between the shelves.
item.remnant_bosses.archivist.set.two: Set (2): Quiet Mind. Blindness and Darkness fade at once.
item.remnant_bosses.archivist.set.four: Set (4): Archive Ward. Negates one projectile hit every 30 s.
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.disabled: The ritual is dormant (disabled or Peaceful difficulty).
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.pattern: Place four Ancient Pedestals 3 blocks from the altar, each with its offering on top. Your Boss Hunts journal names them (by default: amethyst block east, calcite west, chiseled sandstone south, lectern north).
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.nearby: A Forgotten Watcher already keeps its vigil nearby.
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.space: The Watcher needs clear space above the altar.
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.summoned: The lenses turn. The Forgotten Watcher opens its eye!
message.remnant_bosses.watcher.realm: The Watcher remembers only the sky beneath the eclipse. Perform the rite in the Eclipsed Realm.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.clue.forgotte: An observatory crowns the Lantern Heights of the Eclipsed Realm. Its lenses still turn toward a sky that has not moved since the Last Eclipse.
gui.remnant_bosses.journal.lore.forgotte: Seyr built the Watcher to remember everything before the end. It saw the Oracle call every soul to itself, and it remembers whose voice the Oracle was answering. It was built to remember, not to tell.
